item.title: Constant military deployment weakens police, threatens Nigerian democracy – Security analyst

item.title: Naira bounces back to appreciation against US dollar
item.description: The naira on Thursday bounced back to appreciation against the United States dollar at the official foreign exchange market. The Central Bank of Nigeria’s data showed that the Naira strengthened on Thursday to N1,419.28 against the dollar, up from N1,420.04 on Wednesday. item.title: Lagos Taskforce arrests fake naval captain, two others over Oworonshoki demolition
item.description: Lagos State Taskforce has apprehended three suspected impersonators accused of posing as officers of the Nigerian Navy, including a man identified as James K. Robert, who allegedly claimed the rank of Captain, in connection with the demolition of illegal shanties and encroachments on government land in Oworonshoki, Lagos. item.title: AFCON 2025: Everyone is jealous – Egypt coach, Hassan speaks ahead of Super Eagles clash
item.description: Egypt head coach, Hossam Hassan, has claimed that other African teams are jealous of them, because they already have seven AFCON titles.
